title: Subscription Creator Platforms
summary: Subscription platforms like Patreon, OnlyFans and Fansly let fans pay creators monthly for exclusive content, plus tips or paid messages. Some allow adult content (18+, with ID verification); others don't.
key_points: Platforms take a percentage cut of earnings.
Each has its own content rules and payout policies — check current terms.
answer_guidance: Explain neutrally and non-judgementally. Avoid stating current fees or policies as fixed facts.
